Esther Choi shares some of her favorite Korean comfort foods; she makes a classic Korean rice roll, Kimbap, and takes it to the next level with a simple Ramyun; then, she pairs Seafood Japchae with Spinach Namul to keep things fresh and balanced.

Ree Drummond shares family news while cooking for her kids; she makes Orange Chicken and Peppers for Paige and a French Onion Casserole for Alex to have after her baby is born; there are Totally Terrific Cookies and Sloppy Joes To Go for the boys.

title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E05 — Pasta Dinner
Gabe makes hand-rolled Pici all'Aglione and delicate Raviolo al Uovo.

title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E03 — Primo to Secondo
Chef Gabe Bertaccini takes our taste buds to central Italy, beginning with Crespelle alla Fiorentina, delicate Italian crêpes filled with creamy ricotta and spinach. Then, Lamb Chops Scottadito is made complete with a side of Herb Cast-Iron Potatoes.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S39 E01 — Stuff It!
The Kitchen hosts are making all things stuffed; Jeff Mauro kicks off the fun with his authentic Chicago style stuffed deep dish pizza; Geoffrey Zakarian fries up crispy pork and shrimp rolls; Katie Lee Biegel makes her unstuffed mushroom dip.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S36 E07 — Red Light Special Extravaganza
Guy Fieri has plenty of deals to welcome four chefs to Flavortown Market, with red light specials in all 10 aisles; using the red light specials, the chefs must create a fried feast before making a pork dish that's limited to 11 ingredients or fewer.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S37 E07 — Beat the Judges: Express Lane
Guy Fieri challenges three experienced chefs to prepare their best pork dish using only 10 items; the winner earns an automatic $15,000 and can wager up to $5,000 in an express lane seafood battle against the all-star judge of their choice.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S41 E05 — Food Family Takeover
Three restaurant crews featuring family and longtime employees compete.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E02 — Scary Sculpting
Each of the six carvers sculpt a 3D zombie in their likeness, complete with accessories that reflect their personality; the first team challenge requires creating a giant haunted house using a minimum of 15 pumpkins.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E03 — Sky-High Scares
Sunny challenges the carvers to reach new heights and build their biggest pumpkin creations yet, first bringing a frightening phobia to life and then depicting a circus sideshow gone terribly wrong.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E04 — Gourd Games
The final four carvers battle it out to earn the title of "Outrageous Pumpkins Champion"; they create a larger-than-life children's toy with a creepy spin; then, the carvers go all out with a sinister depiction of a popular playground pastime.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Back from the Dead: Halloween All Stars: Part 1
Cake decorators, candy-makers and pumpkin carvers team up to compete to see who can make the biggest, wildest, and spookiest edible Halloween creations in an attempt to win a cash prize.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E02 — Back from the Dead: Things That Go Buzz in the Night
Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create terrifying insect-infested showpieces and daring buzz-worthy desserts inspired by coffee, tea and spirits; after an unexpected twist, judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller execute an elimination.
